body:
## Parent

https://github.com/TabTty/TabTty/issues/4

## What to build

Upload and download selected files or folders through the production file-operation module, with one coherent path for admission, confirmation, progress, cancellation, results, and eligible retry. This is the first working slice of the SFTP refactor and establishes the controlled I/O seam used by the later file-operation slices.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Move transfer policy into the WPF-independent Core module and connect the existing transfer window to its named operations and read-only state. The window no longer owns transfer completion choreography.
- [ ] Use the existing authenticated SSH connection and SFTP implementation. Production and controlled I/O adapters report actual I/O facts; approval, target rechecks, and retry decisions remain in the production policy module.
- [ ] Preserve recursive transfer behavior, staging/replacement, bounded planning, cancellation, and per-entry completed/skipped/failed/unfinished/unknown outcomes. A lost commit reply never causes automatic replay or deletion of the final path.
- [ ] Bind confirmation answers and progress to the operation and connection. Reject stale answers, recheck changed overwrite targets, and release admission without requiring a caller End or disposal call.
- [ ] While the view remains open, reject a new mutation while cancelled transfer I/O is still outstanding. Keep the four-transfer-batch limit distinct from the eight-local-provider-call limit and retain actual provider ownership.
- [ ] Retain the latest transfer result and eligible failed-item retry metadata together; a rejected start preserves both. Retry rechecks items on the original live connection. Existing create/rename/delete paths continue to work during migration under coordinated admission.
- [ ] Exercise the real operation interface with controlled target changes, lost replies, child failure, and delayed completion, and preserve real local-file and SSH/SFTP transfer checks.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).

comments.body:
The transfer window now calls the Core copy and retry operations. The operation owns admission, overwrite confirmation and rechecks, staging, cancellation, and results. Release validation passed for the controlled changed-target, lost-commit, and late-confirmation cases and real local/loopback SSH transfers including nested folders and overwrite. Changes are in the TabTty working tree.

Overall plan [#4](https://github.com/TabTty/TabTty/issues/4).
